response.sql: WITH budget_with_event AS (SELECT b.spent, b.amount, e.event_id, e.type FROM budget b INNER JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id), event_spending_rates AS (SELECT event_id, type, AVG(spent / amount) AS event_avg_rate FROM budget_with_event GROUP BY event_id, type), type_avg_rates AS (SELECT type, AVG(event_avg_rate) AS type_avg_rate FROM event_spending_rates GROUP BY type), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(type_avg_rate) AS mean_rate FROM type_avg_rates) SELECT tar.type, tar.type_avg_rate, tar.type_avg_rate / om.mean_rate AS rate_divided_by_mean FROM type_avg_rates tar CROSS JOIN overall_mean om ORDER BY tar.type
